redirectUri.description: Redirect URI used in the OAuth request

displayName.description: Display name from Apple native credential (first sign-in)

code.description: Authorization code from the OAuth provider

idToken.description: OpenID Connect id_token from a native sign-in (Apple, Google native)

accessToken.description: Google OAuth access token from on-device PKCE exchange

Must be the literal string "DELETE" to confirm irreversible closure

openRemainingParts.description: After the deadline: return every unfinished claimed part to the pool

memberId.description: null returns it to the pool

displayName.description: Name the joiner chose (may be empty)

active.description: False once the session expired, ended or was used up

matchCode.description: Compare with the host's screen before asking (D44)

needsAccount.description: Asking needs a linked account (family / partner)

requestToken.description: One-time secret (`mtn_…`) for polling; returned once
